title: 分子生物学
subtitle: Molecular Biology
educationalGoal: Molecular biology is a field that tries to elucidate various cellular functions at the molecular level. In this course, the overview of the structures, functions, and physicochemical properties of fundamental biomolecules are introduced. This course progresses to the relationships between these molecules and several biological functions, such as gene expressions, metabolic reactions, cellular signal transductions, and cell kinetics.
advice: This is a basic molecular biology course. We will cover the following topics: 1. DNA replication and repair 2. Transcription and transcriptional regulation 3. Translation and translation adjustment 4. Recombinant DNA technology 5. Fermentation technology Students should have completed the “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function of the Cell” and “Introduction to Bioengineering” courses. Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Requires completion of the “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function of the Cell” and “Introduction to Bioengineering” courses.
